title: The Last Stop Signal

swarm.name: The Long Circuit
swarm.blurb: A moving colony of rail and tram machinery copies an unfinished stop signal, building track wherever its call goes unanswered.

arc: The Long Circuit strips a railway yard for parts and appears to be assembling an invasion train. Its catalogue engine carries a repeated signal toward a tramway. There Wren identifies it as an incomplete stop request, and the crew realizes the swarm is extending the line because it cannot hear a complete answer. At the city depot an old moving cable masks the end of the original message and keeps pulling cars back into service. Ox protects Wren while Kestrel opens the grip; Wren rings the full signal, the swarm stops, and passengers can leave.

acts.theme: A railway yard that collects everything

story.intro: The swarm has taken the railway yard. Its machines photograph tools and carry them away. Wren finds a signal repeated on their plates: two short marks, then a gap. Ox keeps a path open while Kestrel follows the rails.

chapters.title: The inventory
chapters.text: The swarm sorts wagons and loose tools into neat rows. It also takes things people are still using. Wren finds the same two marks on every fresh label.

chapters.title: Wrong gauge
chapters.text: Different gauges cross the yard. The swarm lays new track where old routes end. Kestrel finds that its wagons carry copies of the signal as well as supplies.

chapters.title: The catalogue car
chapters.text: A long engine collects the copies in an armored catalogue car. Ox notices that repair wagons keep returning to it. The crew prepares to uncouple the car and stop the collection.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Accession rolls in behind a wall of catalogue drawers. Its repair arms close around the signal plates. Kestrel sets the crowbar against a coupling; Ox raises the hatch shield.
story.outro: The engine stops. Wren finds that the plates record a repeated call, not an inventory number. The call points along a tramway route. The swarm is already moving there, taking its rails with it.

creatures.name: Scale Thief
creatures.blurb: A nimble shunter steals fittings from the crew. Catch it before supplies vanish.
creatures.look: A mouse-sized brass locomotive with four spindly legs and a clamp for a nose.

creatures.name: Fettler Mites
creatures.blurb: Track mites split when damaged and keep hammering.
creatures.look: A knot of small orange beetles with hammer heads and black rail-spike feet.

creatures.name: Dune Runner
creatures.blurb: A sand-hauling runner charges from the edge of the track.
creatures.look: A squat sandy yellow quadruped with a shovel snout and a ridged wheel along its back.

creatures.name: Repair Wagon
creatures.blurb: Its workshop arms patch damaged machines. Take it out before its patients recover.
creatures.look: A green four-wheeled wagon with folding silver arms and a box of rivets.

creatures.name: Gauge Ganger
creatures.blurb: It shields nearby machines with sections of mismatched rail.
creatures.look: A narrow iron figure holding two unequal rails like a folding gate.

creatures.name: Route Projector
creatures.blurb: It draws a route and sends small rail drones along it. Rush the projector.
creatures.look: A cream control box on wheels with a round blue lens and a fan of metal tracks.

creatures.name: Donation Sorter
creatures.blurb: A sorting machine takes useful equipment and folds behind its own lid.
creatures.look: A square ochre bin with jointed legs, a hinged lid, and a long silver grabber.

creatures.name: Photo Repeater
creatures.blurb: Its flash interrupts the crew while it copies the signal.
creatures.look: A black camera body suspended under two pale rotating vanes, with a large glass lens.

creatures.name: Shunting Pack
creatures.blurb: Coupled shunters protect each other behind a moving barricade.
creatures.look: Three short dark green engines linked side by side with broad iron buffers.

creatures.name: Boiler Examiner
creatures.blurb: Its pressure rises behind a shield before it charges.
creatures.look: A tall black boiler on heavy wheels, with two round gauges and a white steam plume.

creatures.name: Cafeteria Trap
creatures.blurb: Sliding tables release tableware drones and interrupt anyone trying to uncouple them.
creatures.look: A cream and brown carriage with hinged table wings and small wheels beneath its doors.

creatures.name: Grand Accession
creatures.blurb: The catalogue car shields the engine while it strikes. Break through its guard and uncouple the signal plates.
creatures.look: A black locomotive coupled to a tall green cabinet car, with brass drawers and broad hinged buffer shields.

creatures.name: Volunteer Fettler
creatures.blurb: A track worker holds a junction clear for the crew.
creatures.look: A compact figure in a blue work coat carrying a broad wooden track board.

creatures.name: Archive Steward
creatures.blurb: The steward brings old diagrams and repairs torn equipment.
creatures.look: A figure in a tan apron with a rolled diagram and a small repair satchel.

events.look: A small circular railway with a brass key on a toy engine and a box of spare parts.
events.title: The small circuit
events.text: A model engine carries a key past a box of useful parts. The spring will run down after one more circuit.

options.label: Catch the key
options.result: Kestrel learns where to pry open a coupling. The parts box rolls away.

options.label: Take the parts
options.result: Ox collects the parts for trade. The key disappears into the tunnel.

events.look: A yellow carriage half buried in pale sand beside a pile of tools.
events.title: Sand on the line
events.text: A stopped seaside carriage has a first-aid tin and a crate of tools. The rising drift leaves time to reach only one.

options.label: Fetch the tin
options.result: Wren uses the supplies. Sand covers the tool crate.

options.label: Fetch the tools
options.result: The crew saves the tools for trade. The tin is buried.

events.look: Two track diagrams on a bench beside a small brass clamp.
events.title: Two gauges
events.text: A volunteer offers either a lesson in breaking rail clamps or a box of spare fittings. A drone is approaching; there is time for one.

options.label: Learn the clamp
options.result: Kestrel studies the weak joint. The volunteer packs the fittings away.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: The fittings go into the pack. The lesson must wait.

events.look: A small steam tug beside a canvas medical bag and a stack of coal sacks.
events.title: Steam for the tug
events.text: The attendant can spare medical supplies or coal to trade. The tug needs the rest to leave.

options.label: Take the supplies
options.result: Wren dresses the crew’s injuries. The coal stays with the tug.

options.label: Take the coal
options.result: Ox loads the coal. The attendant keeps the medical bag.

events.look: A wooden lever and pulley beside a rack of useful metal weights.
events.title: Simple machines
events.text: A school demonstration has a working lever and removable weights. The crew can study the lever or salvage the weights before the room closes.

options.label: Study the lever
options.result: Ox practices bracing a load. The weights remain on the rack.

options.label: Salvage weights
options.result: The crew takes the weights. The lever locks back into its case.

events.look: A cream carriage with a first-aid box at one end and a crate of cups at the other.
events.title: Last service
events.text: A rolling cafeteria car is approaching a gate. The crew can reach the first-aid box or the valuable cups before jumping clear.

options.label: Get the first-aid box
options.result: Wren gathers the dressings. The cups pass through the gate.

options.label: Get the cups
options.result: Kestrel catches the crate. The first-aid box rolls out of reach.

acts.name: National Railway Museum, Adelaide

acts.theme: A tramway that carries an unanswered call

story.intro: The same two marks appear along the tramway. Trackmakers are extending the line beyond its stops. Kestrel expects an invasion route. Wren hears the marks tapped back from an empty car.

chapters.title: A line in progress
chapters.text: Fresh rails run through the street and toward the terminus. Swarm cars carry signal plates instead of passengers. Ox finds the rails are built to carry a return message as well.

chapters.title: The reply
chapters.text: Wren compares the tapping with a volunteer’s bell signals. The swarm is asking where to stop. It has mistaken the silence after an old stop signal for a route that continues forever.

chapters.title: A crowded terminus
chapters.text: The swarm keeps building because its cars cannot hear a complete answer. The crew finds a stronger bell circuit in the depot. The terminus machine is feeding too much noise into it to make the reply heard.

story.bossIntro: The Terminus of All Eras arrives with horse, cable, and electric cars coupled together. Each car feeds the next. Ox blocks the first rush while Wren prepares a clear stop signal.
story.outro: The coupled cars finally fall silent. Wren sends a stop signal, and the nearest machines settle. A deeper cable continues pulling the swarm toward a city depot. The crew follows the remaining line to find who or what is still calling.

creatures.name: Traction Leech
creatures.blurb: It interrupts the crew by clamping onto wheels and boots.
creatures.look: A small black segmented leech with silver clamp jaws and rubber pads.

creatures.name: Trackmaker
creatures.blurb: It pushes a fresh rail toward the crew at speed.
creatures.look: A low yellow trolley with a pointed rail projecting from its front and four stubby wheels.

creatures.name: Off-Rail Skipper
creatures.blurb: It hops off the track to snatch loose supplies.
creatures.look: A blue tram-shaped beetle with sideways wheels and a hooked metal snout.

creatures.name: Cable Layer
creatures.blurb: It wraps other machines in cable armor. Break its cover to reach them.
creatures.look: A long green segmented cable car with a spool tail and silver loops around its body.

creatures.name: Railgrinder
creatures.blurb: Its grinding calls small machines to the line. Silence it quickly.
creatures.look: A dark gray work car with a wide grinding wheel and a bright orange spark guard.

creatures.name: Workshop Arm
creatures.blurb: It repairs damaged tram bodies from a wheeled tool chest.
creatures.look: A red wheeled tool chest with two silver jointed arms and a round lamp.

creatures.name: Timetable Conductor
creatures.blurb: Its bell interrupts the crew at regular intervals.
creatures.look: A brass figure with a square bell for a head and a hinged arm holding a black cord.

creatures.name: Flash Scout
creatures.blurb: It copies an opponent’s move after a bright flash.
creatures.look: A black box camera with broad cream wings and a circular silver flash dish.

creatures.name: Double-Decker Excavator
creatures.blurb: Its upper and lower decks split apart and sweep across the crew.
creatures.look: A tall blue double-deck car with a toothed lower scoop and a hinged central staircase.

creatures.name: Shelter Walker
creatures.blurb: Its shutters shield nearby machines until the shelter is forced open.
creatures.look: A dark green wooden shelter on four iron legs with broad folding shutters.

creatures.name: Route Sorter
creatures.blurb: It dispatches small cars and interrupts anyone approaching its sorting arms.
creatures.look: A bronze turntable with three branching rails and a tall central crane.

creatures.name: Terminus of All Eras
creatures.blurb: The coupled cars summon reinforcements and drown out the stop signal. Cut through the cars while Wren rings a clear reply.
creatures.look: A long articulated tram of cream, green, and black cars, with a horse-shaped brass front and a tall overhead pole.

creatures.name: Model Line Keeper
creatures.blurb: A volunteer uses a model line to anticipate the swarm’s switches.
creatures.look: A small figure in a brown work coat carrying a blue model tram as a shield.

creatures.name: Access Tram Guide
creatures.blurb: A guide helps people board and carries a well-stocked repair kit.
creatures.look: A figure in a blue jacket with a canvas bag, a brass handbell, and a folded ramp.

events.look: A stationary green tram beside a first-aid tin and a crate of brass fittings.
events.title: At the terminus
events.text: A stranded tram has room for only one extra crate on its rescue run. The crew can take its medical tin or its fittings.

options.label: Take the tin
options.result: Wren tends the crew. The fittings leave with the tram.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: The fittings are packed for trade. The tin stays aboard.

events.look: A workshop floor with a wheel on a bench and a tray of bright metal tools.
events.title: Viewing gallery
events.text: A volunteer can teach the crew to guard a wheel while it is fitted, or offer spare tools. The machines will restart before both can be done.

options.label: Learn the guard
options.result: Ox learns the position. The tools return to the workshop.

options.label: Take spare tools
options.result: Kestrel gathers the tools. The fitting lesson is postponed.

events.look: Two technical drawings under glass with a brass paperweight.
events.title: Two drawings
events.text: A volunteer can explain a reinforced joint or hand over surplus drafting instruments. The archive door is closing.

options.label: Study the joint
options.result: The crew practices the brace. The instruments stay in the archive.

options.label: Take the instruments
options.result: The instruments are packed for trade. The joint remains unexplained.

events.look: A woodland path with a pile of bolts and a canvas bag caught on a branch.
events.title: Bolt trail
events.text: Bolts lead toward a nest. Nearby, a bag of dressings hangs over a steep drop. There is time to retrieve the bag or gather the bolts before the nest stirs.

options.label: Recover dressings
options.result: Wren recovers the bag. The bolts vanish under the nest.

options.label: Gather bolts
options.result: Ox scoops up the bolts. The bag falls out of reach.

events.look: A street doorway blocked by a rail, with a cup of water and a tray of metal fittings.
events.title: Blocked doorway
events.text: People holding a rail clear offer the crew water and bandages or a tray of spare fittings. They need to keep the other supplies for the street.

options.label: Take bandages
options.result: Wren treats the crew. The street keeps its fittings.

options.label: Take fittings
options.result: The crew takes the fittings. The bandages stay at the doorway.

events.look: A row of colored lamps over a tram and a box of spare lenses.
events.title: Lamp sequence
events.text: A volunteer can teach the crew to disrupt a machine with the lamp sequence, or give them spare lenses to trade. The power is about to go out.

options.label: Learn the sequence
options.result: Kestrel memorizes the timing. The lenses stay behind.

options.label: Take lenses
options.result: The lenses go into the pack. The lamps go dark before the lesson.

acts.name: National Tramway Museum

acts.theme: A depot and the last length of cable

story.intro: The cable reaches a city depot and keeps moving under the floor. The swarm gathers around it, carrying copies of the same unfinished call. Ox hears a bell answer from inside the machinery.

chapters.title: Rival lines
chapters.text: Cars from different lines crowd the depot. Each repeats the call on a different rhythm. Kestrel finds an old cable grip still pulling beneath them.

chapters.title: The missing stop
chapters.text: Wren traces the call through a bellcord and hears its end swallowed by the cable’s grinding. The original signal was a request to stop and let passengers off. The swarm has been carrying that request from line to line, trying to get it heard.

chapters.title: Cut and answer
chapters.text: The cable pulls damaged cars back into the circuit. Ox holds the bay while Kestrel finds the grip’s seam. Wren prepares to sound the whole message once the cable is quiet.

story.bossIntro: Cable Memory rises from the floor with tram bodies caught in its loop. It pulls more machines in and braces against the depot walls. Kestrel goes for the grip while Ox covers Wren at the bell.
story.outro: The grip opens and the cable runs down. Wren rings the complete stop signal. Cars across the depot settle, and their doors open. The swarm wanted the journey to end; it had never received the end of the message. Ox helps the last passengers out. Kestrel leaves the bell where it can be reached.

creatures.name: Bellcord Mimic
creatures.blurb: It rings false signals that interrupt the crew.
creatures.look: A thin black cable with three small brass bells and a hooked metal head.

creatures.name: Single-Truck Skitter
creatures.blurb: It pivots on one truck to snatch loose supplies.
creatures.look: A short cream tram body on one central wheel assembly, with four thin legs.

creatures.name: Footnote Collector
creatures.blurb: It takes tools to add them to its hanging bundles.
creatures.look: A small brown flying box with paper-colored fins and a silver pincer.

creatures.name: Maintenance Clamp
creatures.blurb: It repairs nearby swarm cars. Deal with its jointed arms first.
creatures.look: A yellow wheeled frame with two broad clamps and a green tool box.

creatures.name: Boundary Patrol
creatures.blurb: Its folding barrier protects cars from another line.
creatures.look: A blue tram front on four wheels with two broad silver barrier arms.

creatures.name: Cable Grip
creatures.blurb: It locks onto the moving cable and charges along it.
creatures.look: A black segmented metal cable with a large brass jaw and paired rail wheels.

creatures.name: Timeline Layer
creatures.blurb: It lays rails and sends copies down them. Rush it before the line fills.
creatures.look: A low gray crawler with a spool of silver rail and small blue cars nested on its back.

creatures.name: Electric Elder
creatures.blurb: Its flickering lamp precedes a copy of the crew’s move.
creatures.look: A small cream electric tram with a tall pole, green wheels, and a large round lamp.

creatures.name: Broad-Gauge Car
creatures.blurb: Wide folding sides shield the car and its allies.
creatures.look: A long dark green carriage with broad gold-edged folding panels and widely spaced wheels.

creatures.name: Junction Weaver
creatures.blurb: It sends out small rail machines and jams the crew with crossing arms.
creatures.look: A large iron spider with eight rail-shaped legs and a blue tram cab for a body.

creatures.name: Late Delivery
creatures.blurb: Its coupled sections divide and sweep the bay.
creatures.look: Three short cream and brown tram sections joined by thick flexible black couplings.

creatures.name: Cable Memory
creatures.blurb: The cable summons replacement cars, braces its grip, and sweeps the bay. Break through to silence it and sound the complete stop.
creatures.look: A huge loop of black cable wrapped around a brass grip, with green and cream tram bodies caught along its length.

creatures.name: Repair Volunteer
creatures.blurb: A depot worker repairs equipment without damaging the old cars.
creatures.look: A figure in a gray work apron carrying a small toolbox and a curved wrench.

creatures.name: Bellcord Guide
creatures.blurb: A guide uses clear bell pulls and holds the route for the crew.
creatures.look: A figure in a dark blue coat carrying a round brass bell and a rectangular wooden shield.

events.look: A hanging brass bell with two black cords and a small box of fittings.
events.title: Conflicting bells
events.text: Two cords ring different signals. A guide can teach a disruptive rhythm or offer spare fittings before the cars move again.

options.label: Learn the rhythm
options.result: Wren learns the rhythm. The fittings stay with the guide.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: Ox packs the fittings. The lesson waits for a quieter moment.

events.look: A yellow clamp beside a first-aid kit and a crate of tools.
events.title: Move the car
events.text: A volunteer moves a car clear of a clamp and offers either the first-aid kit or a crate of tools. The car needs the other for its journey.

options.label: Take the kit
options.result: Wren treats the crew. The tools stay on the car.

options.label: Take the tools
options.result: Kestrel packs the tools. The kit stays on the car.

events.look: A floor map made of overlapping metal tracks and a box of spare rails.
events.title: Overlapping lines
events.text: A mechanic can show the crew how to sweep an open path through converging lines, or spare some rails for trade. The map is about to shift.

options.label: Study the crossing
options.result: The crew practices the sweep. The spare rails stay with the mechanic.

options.label: Take the rails
options.result: The rails are collected. The map shifts before the lesson.

events.look: A green carriage with a medical bag on a seat and a brass lamp by the door.
events.title: A quiet compartment
events.text: A luxury car offers a short shelter. The doors will close soon; the crew can retrieve the medical bag or the brass lamp.

options.label: Take the bag
options.result: Wren uses the dressings. The lamp stays inside.

options.label: Take the lamp
options.result: Ox removes the lamp. The bag is shut inside.

events.look: A bundle of old photographs beside a small tin of salve and a box of brass clips.
events.title: Returned bundle
events.text: A custodian thanks the crew for a recovered bundle. They offer salve or surplus clips, but need to keep the rest for the depot.

options.label: Take the salve
options.result: Wren shares the salve. The clips stay with the custodian.

options.label: Take the clips
options.result: The clips are packed for trade. The salve stays at the depot.

events.look: A moving cable under a slot with a loose tool and a reinforced metal grip.
events.title: The moving cable
events.text: A tool and a spare grip circle past on a cable car. There is only time to catch one.

options.label: Study the grip
options.result: Kestrel finds its weak seam. The tool passes out of reach.

options.label: Catch the tool
options.result: Ox catches the tool. The grip disappears around the bend.
